$comment: An example team setup for Terminal (schema berth.team/v1), for Acme, a made-up org whose shop (acme/shop) needs Node, Postgres and Redis. Terminal reads <org>/.berth/team.json. Placeholders are in README.md; no secrets live here.
name: Acme
description: Everything an Acme engineer needs on their box: system updates, Docker, gh and 1Password CLIs, Node and Yarn, Postgres and Redis in Docker, then the shop cloned, migrated and seeded.

box.$os: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 12 are tested first; macOS (Homebrew with OrbStack, Docker Desktop or Colima) is best effort.
box.$settings_why: The one place these versions live; Terminal gives them to box/setup.sh as BERTH_SETTING_SHOP_POSTGRES_VERSION and BERTH_SETTING_SHOP_REDIS_VERSION, and by hand it reads them from here. A new Postgres major does not move existing data: the step says how.

steps.title: System updates
steps.detail: apt-get update and upgrade (brew update on macOS); counts as done for 24 hours

steps.title: System packages
steps.detail: git, curl, jq, unzip, build tools, python3, openssl, and psql and pg_dump of the Postgres version (PostgreSQL apt repository)

steps.title: Docker
steps.detail: Docker Engine from Docker's apt repository, started at boot, and you in the docker group

steps.title: GitHub CLI and 1Password CLI
steps.detail: gh for the box's own GitHub sign-in and clones; op for the shared keys

steps.title: Node with fnm
steps.detail: the version the shop names (.nvmrc, .node-version or engines), in your home folder, on the PATH of login shells

steps.title: Yarn with corepack
steps.detail: the shop's packageManager picks the version

steps.title: Postgres in Docker
steps.detail: shop-postgres, the version in box.settings (18), on 127.0.0.1:5433, database shop, volume shop-postgres-data, restarts unless stopped

steps.title: Redis in Docker
steps.detail: shop-redis, the version in box.settings (8), on 127.0.0.1:6379, volume shop-redis-data, restarts unless stopped

$agents: The agent CLIs every Acme box gets. Terminal installs them as a step of its own, after the steps above, into ~/.local/bin without sudo (Claude Code with its native installer, Codex from its pinned GitHub release, checksum checked), then their hooks and skills. Each engineer signs in to them on first start.

projects.$id: The project's name on the box. It is part of each worktree's URL (<worktree>.shop.<box>.localhost), so it has no dots.
projects.$kit: Used only while acme/shop has no .berth/config.json of its own. Pinned to a commit, so an update to the kit is a change to this file.
projects.init_detail: once in the main checkout: Node from fnm, .env from .env.example with DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL at the Docker services, yarn install, yarn db:migrate, yarn db:seed
projects.first_task: Find an open issue labelled "good first issue" in acme/shop, explain how you'd fix it, and make the change in a new worktree

keys.$comment: No secrets in git. shared: op:// references, read on the box with the engineer's own 1Password when a worktree needs them. ask: each engineer's own, asked for once and kept on their box. Ports, URLs and databases are the kit's job, not this. Names follow op://dev/dev_<project>_<service>/<field>.
